purpose: Menu screen concept examples; not integrated into the game

prompts.name: title
prompts.prompt:
Stylised toon-shaded game art, flat cel colour in 2-3 tone steps, clean confident ink-brush outline of even weight, muted ukiyo-e colour palette, matte surfaces, soft even lighting with no cast shadows, no photographic or painterly texture, no gloss, no baked ambient occlusion, simple readable shapes.
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished 16:9 full-screen PC game menu concept for Yokai Fighters, a Japanese folklore roguelite fighting game. Full bleed screen, no device frame, no collage. Palette: indigo #2D3A5E, ink #1D1B21, rice paper #F1E8D4, pine #34483B, shrine red #B5332B, persimmon #D8632C. Refined bold editorial layout, generous negative space, extremely legible English UI typography, expressive brush lettering only for major headings. Restrained flat paper shapes and ink separators; no excessive distressed noise. No real kanji, no watermark, no unrelated logos, no photorealism, no glossy UI, no neon.
Title screen. Large stacked title 'YOKAI FIGHTERS' upper left. Left column vertical menu: 'Start', 'Continue', 'Practice', 'Settings', 'Quit'. Start selected with broad shrine-red brush stroke and cream lettering; other entries ink lettering. Bottom left small 'Choose your path.' Right half features three striking flat illustrated theatre masks arranged on a shrine display: a prominent white fox mask with pointed ears and red markings, a muted red oni mask with two short horns and tusks, and a teal kappa mask with a rounded beak and dish on its crown. No tanuki mask. Warm rice-paper backdrop with restrained pine bamboo silhouettes and indigo dusk bands at far right. Sophisticated asymmetrical composition, masks supply drama but leave menu clear. Footer 'ENTER  Confirm'.

Pause menu. Heading 'PAUSED' upper left. Large rice-paper panel takes left 43 percent, vertical entries 'Resume', 'Move list', 'Settings', 'Restart run', 'Quit to title'. Resume selected with shrine-red brush stroke. Right side has a dimmed flat illustrated bamboo fighting stage with two small distant silhouettes facing each other; no detailed character portraits. An orderly rice-paper run-summary panel on the right reads 'CURRENT RUN', 'RYO', '720 / 1000', a simple 72 percent full red health bar, and 'Row 3 of 8 · vs Kitsune'. Sound settings screen. Wide centered rice-paper settings sheet over an indigo and pine bamboo silhouette backdrop. Heading 'SETTINGS'. Two tabs 'Sound' and 'Controls', Sound selected with red underline. Three spacious aligned horizontal slider rows with labels 'Master', 'Music', 'Effects', values '80%', '60%', '90%'. Sliders are clean ink brush tracks, shrine-red filled portions and simple red circular handles placed correctly at 80, 60 and 90 percent. First row focused using a small red arrow and subtle warm highlight. Upper right a small flat white fox mask motif with red markings. Bottom left text 'Adjust the volume.' Bottom right outlined button 'Back'. Footer 'LEFT / RIGHT  Adjust' and 'ESC  Back'. Extremely clean and usable, professionally typeset, carefully aligned, few decorative elements.
